## Skills

- Total: 12
- Available: 10
- Workspace: 0
- Built-in: 12
- Always loaded: `memory`, `my`

- `clawhub` [builtin] — Search and install agent skills from ClawHub, the public skill registry. (available; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; manual)
- `cron` [builtin] — Schedule reminders and recurring tasks. (available; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; manual)
- `github` [builtin] — Interact with GitHub using the `gh` CLI. Use `gh issue`, `gh pr`, `gh run`, and `gh api` for issues, PRs, CI runs, and advanced queries. (available; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; manual)
- `image-generation` [builtin] — Generate images and iteratively edit saved image artifacts. (available; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; manual)
- `long-goal` [builtin] — long-goal (available; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; manual)
- `memory` [builtin] — Two-layer memory system with Dream-managed knowledge files. (available; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; always)
- `my` [builtin] — Check and set the agent's own runtime state (model, iterations, context window, token usage, web config). Use when diagnosing why something doesn't work ("why can't you search the web?", "why did you stop?"), checking resource limits before complex tasks, adapting configuration for long or simple tasks, or remembering user preferences across turns. Also use when the user asks what model you are running, how many tokens you've used, or what your settings are. (available; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; always)
- `skill-creator` [builtin] — Create or update AgentSkills. Use when designing, structuring, or packaging skills with scripts, references, and assets. (available; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; manual)
- `summarize` [builtin] — Summarize or extract text/transcripts from URLs, podcasts, and local files (great fallback for “transcribe this YouTube/video”). ( unavailable: CLI: summarize; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; manual)
- `tmux` [builtin] — Remote-control tmux sessions for interactive CLIs by sending keystrokes and scraping pane output. ( unavailable: CLI: tmux; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; manual)
- `update-setup` [builtin] — update-setup (available; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; manual)
- `weather` [builtin] — Get current weather and forecasts (no API key required). (available; lifecycle=active; verification=unknown; manual)
